assets.label: Écurie ouverte pour grandes montures
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE independent transparent-background PNG game sprite, HWM162-M01, open Yautja mount stable building for Yautja The Long Hunt. This is an ORIGINAL GAME ADAPTATION of Yautja clan architecture, not a claimed canonical film building.
Subject: one complete full-size practical alien stable, 14 metres wide, 10 metres deep, 7 metres tall. A large open front with three spacious bays, the central entrance 4m wide by 5m high, deep interior visible, strong segmented trapezoidal structural columns, broad low-pitched segmented roof, thick functional stone foundation and flush accessible threshold. Do not compress it into a tiny tabletop building: realistic inhabited architectural proportions, large clearances for giant quadruped mounts. Empty bays and clear circulation. All features are integral to the building.
Camera: orthographic, yaw 0 degrees, pitch 35 degrees looking down toward the open front; straight vertical columns and parallel horizontal edges; NOT 45-degree isometric, NOT perspective vanishing points. Natural top-left soft lighting, restrained warm amber light only inside tiny structural insets, clean crisp silhouette.
Materials: weathered dark basalt, aged bronze edge plates, gunmetal joints, subtle rust-red fabric ventilation screens within side openings. Predator/Yautja visual language: angular segmented alien technology integrated into ancient stone, sparse abstract clan marks, utilitarian surfaces. Highly detailed believable game concept render with hand-painted finish; dark desaturated earth palette matching a volcanic alien homeworld.
Composition: entire building INCLUDING roof, all foundations, all feet centered and uncropped. The complete object occupies ONLY 70–75 percent of the canvas; a generous empty TRANSPARENT margin of at least 80px on EVERY side, including beneath foundation. Transparent background with real alpha, no opaque backdrop or checkerboard drawing, no ground plane or landscape, no cast shadow outside the object. No people, no animals, no harnesses, no furniture, no standalone attached props, no decorative terrain.
Text: none. Avoid readable glyphs, labels, diagrams, collage, contact sheet, multiple variations, medieval wooden barn, hay stacks, Gothic spikes, excessive spikes, fluorescent neon, miniature diorama scale, pedestal base. Only one separate building sprite.
assets.review_note: Full building silhouette observed with visible margins. Low alpha background pixels reach canvas edges; actual alpha bounds require final review. No resizing/padding or background edit performed.
